dedupe_keys.name: reseau cyclable et vert toulouse metropole

description: Réseau cyclable et vert - Toulouse Métropole is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Réseau cyclable et vert de Toulouse Métropole. Ce jeu n'est plus maintenu et sera désactivé en septembre 2026. Il est remplacé par le jeu "aménagements cyclables". Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are circulation, mobilité, déplacement, transport, vélo, piste. The portal shows 5,899 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
